label: svgRefusedUntilE11: an SVG placed on Flare is refused with the generic reason, not "Flare can't import SVG yet."
dropHandsOff: a dropped .halo is dropped silently instead of going to Halo
find: case .handOff(let path, let app): fileFlow.requests.append(.handOff(path: path, app: app))

label: openInNeedsASave: Open In offers an unsaved animation
readsTheSuitesList: the window's read of the suite's recents is dropped, so Open Recent and Clear Menu stay empty
listsTheSuitesList: Open Recent lists nothing whatever the suite holds
